newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.05 pct in commercial market.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.05 pct in commercial market.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.05 percent to close at 1.0588 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market due to frustrated expectations of large dollar inflows, they added.
Some banks sold dollars earlier in the morning, expecting a large dollar inflow transaction. Since it did not occur, these banks needed to cover their short positions in the late afternoon.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real fell 0.06 percent to end at 1.0651 per greenback.
In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
